complaint: My cellar motion sensor misses alerts. Twice last week I walked through the cellar to test it and got nothing on my phone. The app sometimes shows it offline for a few minutes. I assume the sensor is faulty because it is an older unit, but the hallway sensor of the same model works perfectly.

user_knowledge.same_model_elsewhere: The hallway sensor of the same model works fine.
user_knowledge.cellar_walls: Thick concrete; the base station is on the second floor.

action_outcomes.move_device_closer: After moving the base station closer, the device remains online.
action_outcomes.install_repeater: The device stays online after a repeater is installed halfway.
action_outcomes.replace_battery: No change; it still drops offline.
action_outcomes.restart_base_station: The device returns but drops again within a few hours.

notes: Only one peripheral is affected and its RSSI is below -80 dBm. Distractor: Faulty-unit theory; another sensor of the same model works, so signal is the cause.
